title: The Battle of Seeds
summary: Lin Dong arrives at the Imperial City of the Great Yan Dynasty with Lin Fan and the Lin Clan team for the Battle of Seeds, which offers only five places in the Hundred Dynasties Battle. Wang Zhong, Wang Yan's elder brother and the Wang Clan's genius, threatens Lin Dong, and the draw puts them in the same group. Lin Dong first beats Huangpu Ying. Wang Zhong then attacks with the Blood Demonic Asura Spear, which drains Yuan Power, but Lin Dong answers with the Heavy Prison Peak and finishes him with four fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. Mo Ling, Lin Langtian, Du Yun, Man Shan and Lin Dong win the five places. Emperor Mo Jingtian rewards them with training in the Sacred Spirit Pool.
events: Lin Dong and the Lin Clan reach the Imperial City; Lin Fan warns him about Wang Zhong.
Wang Zhong and Wang Yan provoke Lin Dong, and Wang Lei taunts Lin Fan about the Wang Clan's win twenty years ago.
Emperor Mo Jingtian announces five places for the Hundred Dynasties Battle and a draw into five groups.
Lin Dong draws Wang Zhong's group and defeats Huangpu Ying.
Wang Zhong fights with the Blood Demonic Asura Spear; Lin Dong counters with the Heavy Prison Peak.
Lin Dong beats Wang Zhong's Blood Demon attack with four fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Mo Ling, Lin Langtian, Du Yun, Man Shan and Lin Dong take the five places.
The emperor grants the winners training in the Sacred Spirit Pool.
cultivation: Emperor Mo Jingtian is judged to be One Yuan Nirvana, stronger than Lin Fan and Wang Lei. Wang Zhong is Manifestation peak.

986.6 造化境大成 has no clear speaker; it comes as Wang Zhong attacks, so it is taken as Wang Zhong's realm (the wiki also gives him advanced/peak Manifestation). It could instead be someone sizing up Lin Dong, who was Manifestation initial at the end of EP48.

No name cards in this show. Cards are face-to-face lines: Wang Zhong 479.7 (speaks to Lin Dong), Wang Lei 460.3 (addressed), Mo Jingtian 552.4 (speaks), Mo Ling 682.2 (speaks to his father), Huangpu Ying 875.2 (introduces himself), Du Yun 950.7 (introduces himself). Man Shan 362.2 is only being pointed out across the hall.
Mo Ling: names.txt / wiki give his debut as S1 EP5 (EP5), but 莫凌 first appears in the subtitles here and this is clearly his introduction as the Third Prince; marked first. Check.
Mo Jingtian is never named in the subtitles (陛下 / 父皇); the name comes from the wiki (Emperor of the Great Yan Empire, anime S5 EP1).
The '四大宗族' are the Lin, Wang, Qin and Huangpu clans by context; not listed on screen.
1153.6 六阳搬山 follows Lin Dong's '接下来 换我了', so probably Lin Dong's move with the Heavy Prison Peak; speaker not certain.
Lin Dong's place is announced as the last one, because the winner is decided by who wins, not who leaves the gate first (1347-1363).
